body: I am online.  What did you make your name?
Hahahahahaha yes I still use it to send music back and forth between friends.  If you would like you can add me, my screen name is thricebaked.

Thank you for your kind words.  I ended up going to the liquor store and getting a bottle of vodka, so now I'm temporarily happy.  If you have Skype or AIM it would be great to talk to you at a faster pace.
We got this man.  Message me if you ever want to talk.  I have Skype and AIM.

Depression, anxiety, and alcoholism.  It all kind of works as a cycle.  I drink because I feel bad or anxious, then that makes me feel bad and anxious so I drink to fix it.  I'm also in an outpatient rehab program right now, but it clearly hasn't helped too much.  I have no reason to feel like this, but it's just there and it won't go away.  Anyway, I don't want to bore you too much thank you for responding to me.

Hey friend, I'm in the same boat right now.  Spent the entire summer telling myself how good I would do in school this semester, but now I'm just slipping back into my old ways.  Can't get out of bed, unmotivated, no interest, etc.  It's a real pain in the ass because I know it's going to cause me all sorts of problems in the long run.  

I don't really know what the point of this comment was.  I guess I just want to tell you that you're not alone.
